events.title: From handwritten school cards to a playable game
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46271230/25e2498b1f7dc43a784dd8ee54363ce69dfbfe6d.jpg These cards started on scrap paper. In high school, my classmates and I drew cards by hand and played against each other. I kept this original photo. Years later, the idea became Cardcraft. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_dN7muLgD6E The 18-second English clip moves from that real paper prototype to today's card editor and a battle. events.summary: Prerecorded English footage from the full development build. This is not a live Q&A. Design your own cards, build a deck and test your ideas in turn-based battles. events.summary: Your idea. Your first card. Your first battle. This free Demo lets you complete the core creative loop: design a card, build a deck, test it in battle and improve the result.
